topics.topic: How element-scoped calls classify `map_index` problems (nonexistent/unrealized or structurally invalid element) among `unknown_reference`, `refused`, `not reached`, or empty result
questions: For element-scoped relations/operations, if `run_id` and `node_id` exist but `map_index` names no realized element (e.g., out of range or never materialized), is that `unknown_reference` or an empty/not-reached result?

When the caller supplies an element shape that is structurally invalid for that node (e.g., `map_index` present for non-mapped node, or absent for mapped node), should this be `unknown_reference`, `refused`, or `not reached`?

topics.topic: Deterministic missing-identity reporting and existence-check order in `store.read_records` identity reads
questions: If multiple named identities are missing in one call, which missing identity is named in the reason text (if any), and in what deterministic order are existence checks performed?

topics.topic: Exact SpooledFile identity fields that must round-trip from trace/preview outputs into `read_spooled_file`
questions: What exact field set is the SpooledFile identity that callers must round-trip from trace/preview outputs into `read_spooled_file`?

topics.topic: Ordering and multiplicity rules for `functions.read_slot` verdicts within each corpus-digest group
questions: Within each corpus-digest group, what is the order of verdict entries, and can there be more than one verdict per (implementation, corpus_digest)?

topics.topic: Per-relation required input signature for `store.read_records` (fields, order, and cardinality)
questions: For each listed relation, what exact argument list (required fields, order, and cardinality) must callers pass?

topics.topic: What `list_records` must return for `runs` (raw stored `Run` records vs computed `runs.read_run` answers)
questions: When listing `runs`, must the surface return raw `Run` records from `store.page_records`, or computed run answers from `runs.read_run` for each run?

topics.topic: Whether `bindings.check_binding_current` returns only model M10 fields or also an extra selected-instance name field
questions: Is "selected instance's name" part of model M10, or an extra field outside M10 that this operation returns?

topics.topic: `get_repair_view` continuation-token validation/refusal rules when implementation set or page size changes across pages
questions: What exact validation and refusal behavior applies when a continuation token is well-formed but carries an implementation set that differs from the slot’s current set (for example after new implementations are added), or when caller-supplied page size changes across pages?
